messages.subject: Instructions - Penrose v Caldervale expert report
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Dr Holloway,

Further to our call, please treat this as your formal instruction. We enclose the OrchestraOS acceptance-test logs, the SKU master files of 18 and 26 September 2024, the host-environment monitoring data and Caldervale's DC throughput records. The key questions are (a) whether the system as supplied was capable of 650 u/h/zone and 98% availability, and (b) the cause of the measured shortfall.

Kind regards
Elena Marchetti
Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.snippet: Dear Elena, My report is attached. In summary: the system was capable of the contractual performance
messages.subject: RE: Instructions - Penrose v Caldervale expert report
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

My report is attached. In summary: the system was capable of the contractual performance (clean-data, in-profile periods averaged 671 u/h/zone), and I attribute the 129 u/h shortfall ~45% to SKU-master inaccuracy, ~36% to host-latency throttling and ~19% to the out-of-profile promotional surge - all host-side. Availability issues were largely host-network related. Happy to discuss before exchange.

Dr Alan Holloway
Holloway Intralogistics Consulting
